mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_items (id, project_id, title, notes, due_at, priority) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{notes}, #{dueAt}, #{priority})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN work_records wr ON wr.todo_id = t.id AND wr.source = 'TASK_COMPLETION' AND wr.is_active WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE todo_items SET project_id = #{projectId}, title = #{title}, notes = #{notes}, due_at = #{dueAt}, priority = #{priority}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE todo_items SET status = 'PENDING', completed_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todo_items SET version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todo_items SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, todo_id, event_type, payload ->> 'title' AS title, NULLIF(payload ->> 'projectId', '')::uuid AS project_id, NULLIF(payload ->> 'fromStatus', '') AS from_status, NULLIF(payload ->> 'toStatus', '') AS to_status, (payload ->> 'version')::bigint AS version, COALESCE(payload ->> 'result', '') AS result, occurred_at FROM task_events WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} ORDER BY occurred_at, created_at, id
